svg.text: Attendance counter (Arduino Uno). Bright = do it now, faded = already done.
1. Buzzer: + leg in 20c, - leg in 23c. Wire 20a -> D9. Wire 23a -> top BLUE (-) rail
2. Button 1 (green) across the gap: legs in 30e, 32e, 30f, 32f. Wire 30j -> D12. Wire 32j -> bottom BLUE (-) rail
3. Button 2 (red) across the gap: legs in 38e, 40e, 38f, 40f. Wire 38j -> A0. Wire 40j -> bottom BLUE (-) rail
